basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Seattle, currently working as a freelance Android developer. My interests include customizing Android devices, traveling, and exploring new tech trends. I'm not a fan of overly restrictive environments, which is why I love the flexibility of Android. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I'm single and enjoy sharing my knowledge with others while learning from different communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have spent the last 5 years working in mobile app development. I taught myself how to root and customize Android devices through online tutorials and forums. My work often involves troubleshooting and optimizing Android applications.
